title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: Raw mono audience recording that sounds surprisingly clear, featuring an epic Dark Star Jam/Spanish Jam/Lovelight sequence with all‑star guests.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers are uniformly enthusiastic, praising the historic guest lineup and the towering Dark Star‑>Spanish Jam‑>Lovelight stretch.  While the tape is a raw, crunchy mono audience capture, it is described as clear enough to appreciate every guest contribution, making it a must‑have for fans despite the missing opening “Not Fade Away” and “Cumberland”.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with standout jams and guest musicians (70% weight) combined with a raw but listenable audience recording that reviewers deem “great” (30% weight).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono audience tape, described as raw and crunchy yet clear; no major drop‑outs reported, just the usual limitations of a live AUD source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the second‑half jam sequence, noting that the opening “Not Fade Away” and “Cumberland” are missing from this release but the guest‑filled Dark Star segment more than compensates.

band_member_comments.Drums: Guest drummer Butch Trucks noted as tight and adding to the jam’s power
